trailhead.label: Montandré village, by the chapel and the old school (official start; park at the chapel)

cautions: About 1.2 km on the asphalt road to the Col du Sapey, with cars.
A few fairly steep sections on the climb to Grenis (official).
Three small fords on seasonal streams; a rock edge beside the path by the Grenis chapel.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
